Cincinnati Zoo's care team is providing around-the-clock veterinary care for Fiona the hippo after she swallowed a knit hat that accidentally entered her enclosure. The hat reportedly became caught in a ceiling fan before being propelled into Fiona's habitat, where she ingested it. Zoo officials say surgery is not an option, but veterinarians and animal care specialists are doing everything possible to help her pass the object safely. The team has conducted medical examinations, including a colonoscopy, and continues to closely monitor her condition. Staff remain cautiously optimistic that Fiona, who became an international sensation after her premature birth in 2017, will make a full recovery. @cincinnatizoo #fiona #hippo #news
